name: Park toward the human (ask_human)
description: When the coordinator decides it cannot progress by rule and needs a human — next_action == ask_human — record run.awaiting.human on the run entity and post the question to the channel-agnostic user-response bus. The run then waits for a human signal; no Go reconciler, backstop ticker, or app-side state machine advances it while parked (G2/B3/B7). The reason carried by the decision is surfaced to the human. run.awaiting.human's single writer is this park rule (G5). Park is marker-only: it does NOT reflect the phase, to avoid conflating with the change-approval awaiting_approval gate (a run can await a human for either reason, distinguished by the fact, not the phase). FORWARD CONTRACT for later groups (design D15): rules that advance or terminate a run MUST exclude runs with run.awaiting.human present, and the `respond` handler (group 5) MUST remove run.awaiting.human on resume so a resumed run is not read as still-parked. The agent.run.entity-id guard is the run-less-chat guard (semteams agent-run/07): without a run anchor the subject would not resolve and the marker would be silently dropped.
